source: ESPN public injury report and game summaries

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.short_comment: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.
injuries.long_comment: Schroder remains out indefinitely with a hamstring strain. With Charlotte already eliminated from knockout-round contention in the NBA Cup, it's possible the veteran's point guard's absence extends into mid-December.

injuries.name: Grayson Allen
injuries.short_comment: Allen (concussion) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus Chicago.
injuries.long_comment: Allen has missed the last three games. While it appears he's working toward returning, he's not a lock to get back on the floor Wednesday against the Bulls. If Allen remains on the shelf, Sion James (thigh) and Christian Anderson may continue to see more minutes.

injuries.name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
injuries.short_comment: Kalkbrenner (hip) is doubtful to play Wednesday against the Bulls.
injuries.long_comment: Kalkbrenner suffered the hip injury during Monday's 117-111 loss to the Bulls and is now in danger of missing Wednesday's game. If he's out, Hannes Steinbach will have a chance to get into the rotation.

injuries.name: Sion James
injuries.short_comment: James is probable for Wednesday's game against the Bulls due to general soreness.
injuries.long_comment: James is experiencing some soreness on the left side of his body, but he's expected to power through it Wednesday. James is averaging 5.8 points, 3.8 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 1.1 triples per game this season.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.short_comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
injuries.long_comment: Knueppel missed the first eight games of the 2026-27 campaign. He returned for the 114-104 loss to Brooklyn on Wednesday, though he exited the contest after just six minutes of work and didn't return. With Knueppel out of commission for at least a month, Grayson Allen and Sion James are candidates to replace him in the starting lineup, especially with Dennis Schroder (hamstring) sidelined for a minimum of two weeks.

injuries.name: Norman Powell
injuries.short_comment: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.
injuries.long_comment: Powell sustained the hamstring injury in Friday's loss to the Wizards and is now set to miss at least the next two contests. With the veteran swingman on the shelf, Isaac Okoro, Buddy Hield, Tre Jones and Patrick Williams are all candidates for increased playing time.

injuries.name: Jalen Smith
injuries.short_comment: Smith (illness) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Hornets.
injuries.long_comment: Smith has been a regular on the injury report recently due to a gastrointestinal illness, though he played in Chicago's last two outings, averaging 18.5 points, 5.0 rebounds, 2.5 assists and 2.0 combined steals-plus-blocks in 29.5 minutes per contest over that brief stretch. If the big man is unable to play Wednesday, Nic Claxton would likely enter the first unit.

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.short_comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injuries.long_comment: The rookie forward went down during Wednesday's loss to the Spurs, and he now needs surgery to repair a fractured right hand. More pressure will likely fall on Josh Giddey going forward, while the likes of Tre Jones and Isaac Okoro will have a chance for added streaming value.
